subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline first, or require a broader daily/weekly calendar and rescheduling design before implementation?
rationale: This is a new Control UI product capability rather than a broken existing contract, and the open implementation candidate is stale, conflicting, and narrower than the full request.

options.title: Accept Narrow Timeline First
options.body: Rebase or replace the linked PR against the current cron page, preserve current scheduler/status/i18n contracts, and track broader day/week/editing behavior separately.

options.title: Design Full Calendar Scope First
options.body: Pause the current branch and require a product design covering daily, weekly, quick stats, drag-and-drop, and validation behavior before implementation.

options.title: Decline Core Calendar View
options.body: Close the issue and linked PR if maintainers decide the current list and run-history UI is enough for OpenClaw core.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Timeline First
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the linked PR against the current cron page, preserve current scheduler/status/i18n contracts, and track broader day/week/editing behavior separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron UI work makes steipete the strongest available routing signal for the Control UI product-scope decision.
